changes.note: Express 5 no longer supports app.del(); an error is thrown. Use app.delete() for DELETE routes.

Only the app.param(fn) signature (a single function argument, deprecated since v4.11.0) is removed in Express 5; app.param(name, fn) still exists. A text search cannot distinguish the two signatures, so any app.param use is flagged for review.
changes.replacement: app.param(name, fn) with a named parameter, or plain middleware

changes.note: req.param(name) was removed in Express 5; look the value up explicitly in req.params, req.query, or req.body.
The lowercase res.sendfile() was replaced by the camel-cased res.sendFile() in Express 5.
Method names were pluralized in Express 5; the singular req.acceptsCharset() is no longer supported.
Method names were pluralized in Express 5; the singular req.acceptsEncoding() is no longer supported.
Method names were pluralized in Express 5; the singular req.acceptsLanguage() is no longer supported.
React Router v6 removed <Switch>; all <Switch> elements must be upgraded to <Routes>.
React Router v6 removed <Redirect>; it becomes <Navigate> in v6.
React Router v6 removed useHistory; use useNavigate and its navigate() calls instead of history.push/replace/goBack.
React Router v6 removed the withRouter higher-order component; use hooks to access router state instead.
